lenormand-01.name: Rider
lenormand-01.meaning: Something is on its way to you: a message, a visitor or a quick turn of events. Things may move faster than you expect, so be ready to respond.

lenormand-02.name: Clover
lenormand-02.meaning: A little luck and a lighter mood. The chance is small and won't last long, so take it while it's here and don't overthink it.

lenormand-03.name: Ship
lenormand-03.meaning: Movement towards something new: a trip, a move or a longing for somewhere else. Progress may feel slow, but the direction is clear.

lenormand-04.name: House
lenormand-04.meaning: Home, comfort and the people closest to you. Ask what makes you feel safe and steady, and build on it.

lenormand-05.name: Tree
lenormand-05.meaning: Slow, steady growth and deep roots. What you nurture now takes time, so tend it patiently and look after your energy.

lenormand-06.name: Clouds
lenormand-06.meaning: Things are hazy for now. Avoid big decisions while the view is unclear; wait for the clouds to pass and the picture to sharpen.

lenormand-07.name: Snake
lenormand-07.meaning: A winding path, a complication or someone with their own agenda. Stay alert and think a few steps ahead; the direct route may not be the best one.

lenormand-08.name: Coffin
lenormand-08.meaning: Something is coming to an end so something new can begin. Let it go gently, and give yourself time to rest before you start again.

lenormand-09.name: Bouquet
lenormand-09.meaning: A gift, a compliment or a happy surprise. Accept kindness when it comes, and notice the small beautiful things around you.

lenormand-10.name: Scythe
lenormand-10.meaning: A quick decision or a sudden turn. Sometimes cutting something away is necessary; just be careful and deliberate when you do.

lenormand-11.name: Whip
lenormand-11.meaning: Arguments, tension or a pattern that keeps repeating. Ask what keeps coming back, and whether it's time to talk it through or break the cycle.

lenormand-12.name: Birds
lenormand-12.meaning: Phone calls, chatter and busy thoughts. You may feel a little on edge; share what's on your mind with someone you trust.

lenormand-13.name: Child
lenormand-13.meaning: Something new and small is starting. Approach it with curiosity and a fresh eye, and let yourself be a beginner.

lenormand-14.name: Fox
lenormand-14.meaning: Be smart and a little careful. Not everything is as it seems, so check the details and look after your own interests.

lenormand-15.name: Bear
lenormand-15.meaning: Power, resources and a strong presence, perhaps a protective person or someone in charge. Use your strength wisely and look after what you have.

lenormand-16.name: Stars
lenormand-16.meaning: Clarity and hope after a long night. Your goals are in view, so follow your inner compass and trust that you're on the right path.

lenormand-17.name: Stork
lenormand-17.meaning: A welcome change or an improvement is on the way. Something is shifting for the better; let it carry you somewhere new.

lenormand-18.name: Dog
lenormand-18.meaning: A loyal friend or someone you can count on. Lean on the people who stand by you, and be that friend for someone else.

lenormand-19.name: Tower
lenormand-19.meaning: Rules, institutions and a bit of distance. You may need firm boundaries, or time on your own to see your situation from above.

lenormand-20.name: Garden
lenormand-20.meaning: Groups, events and public life. Step out and connect; the answer may come through other people or a social setting.

lenormand-21.name: Mountain
lenormand-21.meaning: Something stands in your way. It won't move quickly, so be patient, find another route, or climb it one step at a time.

lenormand-22.name: Crossroads
lenormand-22.meaning: Several paths lie in front of you. Take time to weigh your options; there's more than one way forward, and the choice is yours.

lenormand-23.name: Mice
lenormand-23.meaning: Small worries or losses that slowly add up. Notice what is draining your time, energy or money, and deal with it before it grows.

lenormand-24.name: Heart
lenormand-24.meaning: Love, warmth and what matters to your heart. Lead with kindness, and let your feelings guide you.

lenormand-25.name: Ring
lenormand-25.meaning: A promise, a partnership or an agreement. Think about the commitments you've made, and which ones you truly want to keep.

lenormand-26.name: Book
lenormand-26.meaning: Something isn't known yet, or is being kept private. Keep learning and asking; the answer will show itself in time.

lenormand-27.name: Letter
lenormand-27.meaning: A message, a note or something in writing. Pay attention to what is said and written, and say what you need to say clearly.

lenormand-28.name: Gentleman
lenormand-28.meaning: Often stands for you, the person asking, or for a man in your life. Look at the cards beside him to see what surrounds him.

lenormand-29.name: Lady
lenormand-29.meaning: Often stands for you, the person asking, or for a woman in your life. Look at the cards beside her to see what surrounds her.

lenormand-30.name: Lily
lenormand-30.meaning: Calm, maturity and quiet contentment. Slow down, act with grace, and trust the wisdom you've gathered over time.

lenormand-31.name: Sun
lenormand-31.meaning: Warmth, energy and success. Things are going your way; step into the light and let yourself shine.

lenormand-32.name: Moon
lenormand-32.meaning: Recognition, emotions and your inner world. Your efforts may be noticed; listen to your intuition and your dreams.

lenormand-33.name: Key
lenormand-33.meaning: The solution is in your hands. A door, an answer or an opportunity opens, and it matters more than it seems.

lenormand-34.name: Fish
lenormand-34.meaning: Money, business and the flow of resources. Abundance comes from keeping things moving, so share, trade and spend your energy wisely.

lenormand-35.name: Anchor
lenormand-35.meaning: Stability and commitment to the long haul. Hold steady and keep going; what you build now will last.

lenormand-36.name: Cross
lenormand-36.meaning: A burden or responsibility you carry. It may feel heavy, but it has meaning; ask what it is teaching you, and where you can ask for help.
